_comment: Rules used by 'Auto-detect' in the Name inputs window. They run in this order; each
one only sees elements not taken by an earlier rule. Positions are fractions of the
controller body (x: 0 left .. 1 right, y: 0 top .. 1 bottom); sizes are fractions of
the body width. 'face' sizes refer to the face buttons found by the first rule.
Confidence: each rule scores how well the geometry fits (0-1), multiplies it by its
'confidence' (the best it can claim) and keeps results at or above 'min_confidence'.
A copy in %APPDATA%\pawz\auto-detect.json, if present, is used instead of this file.

body.comment: the body is the largest shape; others must be smaller than max_size

rules.comment: Four same-size buttons in a diamond on the right half.
Four separate arrows in a diamond on the left half, mirroring the face buttons.
Round, 1.3 to 2.4 times a face button. Right: right half, nearest the face buttons. Left: left half, same size; mirror symmetry raises confidence.
One d-pad block on the left half, where the right stick or the face buttons would be mirrored.
Small buttons mirrored around the centre: the widest pair is Back/Start (minus/plus, share/options), the next Misc/Guide (capture/home).
A small button alone on the centre line.
A wide rectangle centred near the top: a touchpad.
